payload.root_cause: Threshold was set 2026-05-28 (commit d1be505048) before FR-5 same-section dedup (commit 0ae36a0eb, 2026-06-28) existed. FR-5 now correctly drops one legitimate duplicate row (spurious code '868' on page 8, caused by an income-statement EPS-line 4-value-column layout bleeding a value token into the code position), dropping the raw count from 80 to 79. The threshold was never updated after FR-5 shipped.
payload.distinct_from: This is NOT the balance-gate bug FIX-BCTC-FPT-BT5-BALANCE-GATE targeted. That bug (43T VND balance imbalance, root-caused in domain/primitives/vn_number_normalize) is fixed and independently verified (balance_pass=True, delta=0.0). This rows_stored assertion is the FIRST assertion in the test file and short-circuits before the balance_pass assertion is ever reached, so the test still shows FAILED overall despite the balance-gate metric itself being correct.
recommended_options: Update the stale >=80 threshold to >=79 with an explicit comment referencing FR-5's dedup fix
Tighten locate_balance_sheet_pages() section-boundary detection to exclude page 8 (income-statement bleed)
Harden the code-row regex family to reject value-column tokens on income-statement-shaped multi-value lines
